about: Each series' values across several dimensions, as a polygon on one spoke per dimension. Every spoke reads one scale, and the polygon's shape follows the order of the spokes, so a radar shows a profile while a bar chart compares values.

coverage.about: scale writes the radius ticks up the spoke at 12 o'clock. valueDomain fixes the scale at 0 to 100, and valueOptions writes each value in percent. The six ticks step a top of 100 by 20.
coverage.caption: The CLI is the one module under 60% covered.
coverage.label: Test coverage by module
coverage.title: Scale

drop.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at a spoke when the chart first renders. The heading names the spoke, and a row per series writes its value.
drop.caption: Cost fell from 6 to 4, the one score below last quarter's.
drop.title: Tooltip

narrow.about: The scorecard in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The spokes' names fit around the web.
narrow.title: Narrow room

order.about: The scorecard with Cost and Throughput swapped. Every score is the same, and the polygons change shape, so compare radars only with their spokes in one order.
order.caption: The scorecard's scores with two spokes swapped render other shapes.
order.title: Order of spokes

profile.about: One series, filled in the teal palette's chart color: the profile a radar is for. The legend renders for two series or more.
profile.caption: The platform team is strongest on backend work and weakest on design.
profile.label: Skills of the platform team out of 10
profile.title: One profile

quiet.about: A radar chart without rows renders the empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Checkout service scores this quarter.
quiet.empty: No scores for this quarter yet.
quiet.title: Empty

replay.about: animate grows each polygon from the centre when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the polygons at once.
replay.title: Animation

scorecard.about: Two quarters of a service's scores out of 10 on five dimensions. valueDomain fixes the scale at 0 to 10 on every spoke, and each polygon fills at 0.25 of its color.
scorecard.caption: Cost is the only score that fell this quarter, from 6 to 4.
scorecard.label: Checkout service scores out of 10
scorecard.title: Scorecard

teams.about: Three teams as outlines: filled false leaves each polygon unfilled, so the edges of three overlapping shapes can be told apart.
teams.caption: Identity leads on reliability and coverage, and search on latency.
teams.label: Team scores out of 10
teams.title: Outlines

title: Radar chart
